reading.body:
CyrusOne Wappingers Falls is a 3 MW, 100,000 square foot data center, the only New York facility with a published power capacity figure, and far too small for modern AI training or large inference clusters.

The 3 MW footprint places it in regional colocation, not hyperscale. A single modern GPU cluster can consume 50, 100 MW, so this campus cannot host a large training run or inference cluster as a standalone facility. Its SSAE 16 Type II certification qualifies it for audited financial and operational controls, but that does not change the power ceiling.

New York has 31 mapped data center locations, yet this is the only one with a published capacity figure on the operator's spec page. The facility's prominence in the data therefore reflects low disclosure rather than dominance in the state's actual portfolio. The record also lacks an address, nearest airport, and any announced expansion, so it cannot show whether this site is connected to larger AI infrastructure or likely to grow.
